rule: Owner-collected field data (field tests, bowfishing trip logs, handheld measurements, sonar transects, field-observation quotas) is OPTIONAL. It never blocks research completion, a capability dimension, candidate scoring, readiness or internal app testing. Existing observations may still be used as evidence.

acceptedValidationMethods.what: held-out historical measurements or observations (agency surveys, monitoring networks), with the test pre-declared
comparison with public environmental or biological datasets (USGS, NOAA, ASOS/NDBC, LTRM, NWIS, state agencies)
leave-lakes-out or leave-years-out transfer between independent sites
comparison against independent models, reanalysis or physical theory with reported error
published peer-reviewed evidence for the mechanism, graded by directness (transferable studies are evidence, not validation)
an offline analysis that the validator re-runs from hashed evidence
replay of existing records (including any owner-supplied logs) against what the Brain would have said, with ABSTAIN counted

notes: Optional means optional: a record of what owner data WOULD add stays in <folder>/research/data-acquisition/ (status OPTIONAL_OWNER_DATA) and never changes a gap status or an outcome.
Human approval gates (release promotion, product decisions, protected sealed holdouts) are NOT field testing and are unchanged by this policy.

A score or readiness item may be replaced by an evidence-based validation method only through a versioned contract with regression tests; accuracy is never fabricated and a missing validation stays visible as such.

A data request for records that already exist (agency, operator) is not owner-collected; it blocks only when it is the single remaining route. An experiment or an agent may mark such a request `optional: true` when public-data avenues remain.
